turns.content: My local football team just won their first league title in 23 years. The atmosphere at the ground was unbelievable.
23 years — that's a generational moment for supporters. Were you there for the decisive match?
I was. We won 2-1 in the 89th minute. I've never heard noise like it.
Late winners in title-clinching games are almost mythological when you experience them live. How long have you been following the club?
Since I was about seven, so coming up on 30 years. My dad used to take me.
There's something about long-term support that makes moments like this carry so much more weight.
He passed away a few years ago but he always said he thought he'd see it one day. I was thinking of him a lot.
That's a beautiful thing — carrying someone to a moment they believed in. I hope it felt like something shared.
